steps.name: repair-aws-1m-task81-leaf-candidate-snapshot
command: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS ecaz; ALTER EXTENSION ecaz DROP FUNCTION ec_spire_index_scan_leaf_candidate_snapshot(oid, real[]); DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS ec_spire_index_scan_leaf_candidate_snapshot(oid, real[]); CREATE FUNCTION ec_spire_index_scan_leaf_candidate_snapshot(index_oid oid, query real[]) RETURNS TABLE (active_epoch bigint, effective_nprobe bigint, effective_nprobe_source text, effective_rerank_width bigint, effective_rerank_width_source text, pid bigint, node_id bigint, local_store_id bigint, object_version bigint, object_bytes bigint, route_count bigint, scanned_count bigint, candidate_row_count bigint, leaf_block_available_count bigint, leaf_block_selected_count bigint, leaf_block_skipped_count bigint, leaf_summary_object_bytes bigint, leaf_row_object_bytes bigint, primary_candidate_row_count bigint, boundary_replica_candidate_row_count bigint, deduped_candidate_row_count bigint, truncated_candidate_row_count bigint, candidate_winner_count bigint, leaf_object_read_nanos bigint, leaf_summary_score_nanos bigint, leaf_row_score_nanos bigint, candidate_score_nanos bigint, candidate_materialize_nanos bigint, candidate_heap_append_nanos bigint) STRICT STABLE LANGUAGE c AS '$libdir/ecaz', 'ec_spire_index_scan_leaf_candidate_snapshot_wrapper'; ALTER EXTENSION ecaz ADD FUNCTION ec_spire_index_scan_leaf_candidate_snapshot(oid, real[]); SELECT proname, oidvectortypes(proargtypes) AS args FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'ec_spire_index_scan_leaf_candidate_snapshot';

steps.name: precheck-aws-1m-task81-nprobe128-surface
command: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS ecaz; SELECT now() AS captured_at, current_database() AS database_name, version() AS postgres_version; SELECT count(*) AS corpus_rows FROM task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_corpus; SELECT count(*) AS query_rows FROM task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_queries; SELECT i.relname AS index_name, am.amname, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(i.oid)) AS index_size, i.reloptions FROM pg_index x JOIN pg_class i ON i.oid = x.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = x.indrelid JOIN pg_am am ON am.oid = i.relam WHERE t.relname = 'task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_corpus' ORDER BY i.relname; WITH q AS (SELECT source FROM task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_queries ORDER BY id LIMIT 1) SELECT effective_nprobe, leaf_block_available_count, leaf_block_selected_count, leaf_block_skipped_count, leaf_summary_object_bytes, leaf_row_object_bytes, leaf_summary_score_nanos, leaf_row_score_nanos FROM q, LATERAL ec_spire_index_scan_leaf_candidate_snapshot('aws_spire_1m_rabitq_t80_block16_tg256_idx'::regclass, q.source) LIMIT 1; SELECT name, setting, context FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('ec_spire.leaf_block_rows', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_max_blocks_per_leaf', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_max_global_blocks', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_global_probe_blocks', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_sample_rows_per_block', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_sample_summary_prior_weight', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_summary_radius_weight', 'ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_route_prior_weight', 'ec_spire.max_routing_expansions', 'ec_spire.nprobe', 'ec_spire.rerank_width') ORDER BY name;

steps.name: diagnostics-spire-1m-rabitq-block-summary-global1152-nprobe128
command: SET ec_spire.nprobe = 128; SET ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_max_blocks_per_leaf = 0; SET ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_max_global_blocks = 1152; SET ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_global_probe_blocks = 0; SET ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_sample_rows_per_block = 0; SET ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_sample_summary_prior_weight = 0.8; SET ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_summary_radius_weight = 0.25; SET ec_spire.leaf_block_pruning_route_prior_weight = 0.0; WITH queries AS (SELECT id, source FROM task67_1m_hnsw_m7g2xlarge_queries ORDER BY id LIMIT 500), per_leaf AS (SELECT q.id, s.* FROM queries q CROSS JOIN LATERAL ec_spire_index_scan_leaf_candidate_snapshot('aws_spire_1m_rabitq_t80_block16_tg256_idx'::regclass, q.source) s) SELECT count(DISTINCT id) AS query_count, sum(candidate_row_count) AS candidate_rows, sum(leaf_block_available_count) AS blocks_available, sum(leaf_block_selected_count) AS blocks_selected, sum(leaf_block_skipped_count) AS blocks_skipped, sum(leaf_summary_object_bytes) AS summary_bytes, sum(leaf_row_object_bytes) AS row_bytes, sum(leaf_summary_score_nanos) AS summary_score_nanos, sum(leaf_row_score_nanos) AS row_score_nanos, sum(candidate_score_nanos) AS candidate_score_nanos FROM per_leaf;
